task.title: Find why a serve test leaves `git push` processes behind
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M86). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Three idle `git push` processes from a three-day-old temporary directory of `TestRunServeCapsWritesWhileAPushHoldsTheWriteSlot` were found running on the benchmark machine. The test is not relic code.

## Wanted

Find why the test can leave them, and make it stop them on every exit path.

## Done when

- The cause is recorded.
- The test leaves no process behind when it passes, fails or times out.
